departments.name: Order Fulfillment & Logistics
departments.description: Manages order picking, warehouse dispatch, carrier shipping, lost package claims, and delivery tracking across fulfillment networks.

departments.name: Billing & Payment Operations
departments.description: Handles payment gateway processing, card authorization disputes, duplicate billing, VelvoPay wallet refunds, and promo code adjustments.

departments.name: Returns & Reverse Logistics
departments.description: Oversees Return Hub operations, return inspection triage, return label issuance, shipping fee disputes, and restocking authorization.

departments.name: Product Quality & Vendor Assurance
departments.description: Investigates defective products, counterfeit item reports, supplier authenticity verifications, missing parts, and manufacturer warranty claims.

departments.name: Account Management & Customer Care
departments.description: Manages buyer profiles, VelvoCart Prime subscription lifecycle, customer service agent escalations, and general customer support.

departments.name: Trust & Safety (Fraud & Security)
departments.description: 24/7 fraud prevention unit handling account takeovers, unauthorized credit card purchases, identity theft, phishing scams, and stolen credentials.
departments.notes: 24/7 rapid response team. Priority P0 SLA handling.

departments.name: Marketplace & Seller Operations
departments.description: Manages 3rd-party vendor onboarding, seller policy enforcement, buyer-seller messaging disputes, non-responsive seller penalties, and seller store suspensions.

departments.name: Compliance & Legal Affairs
departments.description: Handles regulatory compliance, FTC/BBB inquiries, data privacy rights (CCPA/GDPR), formal attorney letters, and legal liability claims.
departments.notes: Mandatory intake for any legal notice, privacy complaint, or regulator filing.

departments.name: Executive Escalations & Customer Relations
departments.description: Highest level internal resolution team for high-risk customer complaints, repeat unresolved issues, social media escalations, and executive management cases.

escalation_matrix.description: Defines routing rules when an e-commerce complaint exceeds primary department SLA or triggers mandatory risk escalation.
triggers_for_immediate_exec_escalation: 3+ failed resolution attempts on same order
Public social media viral complaint flag
Attorney involvement or formal legal notice
Counterfeit or unsafe product hazard claim
